acknowledged.description: Whether the worker's sign-off is present on the record.

attributes.description: Every remaining form answer, keyed by the tenant's own question text.

evidence_ref.description: Reference to the signed form or attached evidence.

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source record (Assignar form-result id, cast to text).

financial_period.description: The accounting period the acknowledgement falls in, derived from `occurred_at`.

form_id.description: The source form template id — which policy-document form produced the record.

form_title.description: Human-readable template title; the policy document the form belongs to.

occurred_at.description: When the acknowledgement form was submitted; the event time and the retention clock.

policy_reference.description: The policy/procedure identifier or code the form is about.

policy_version.description: The revision of the policy that was acknowledged.

source_system.description: Originating system; `ASSIGNAR` today, SignOnSite if ever bound.

worker.description: The worker who acknowledged the policy; the required subject anchor.
